marketing_description: The NUVO® Wrap Fixture (part 65-1210) provides 20 W of LED illumination at 120‑277 V, delivering 3,200‑3,400 lm with a 2700 K color temperature and CRI 90+. Housed in a white‑finished steel enclosure with an IP44‑rated polycarbonate lens, the linear, ceiling‑mount design includes a 2‑ft backplate, E26 base bulb, and 110° beam angle. The non‑dimmable unit operates at 0.17 A, 50/60 Hz and is rated for an average life of 50,000 hours.
